card.name: Gap after a dateline before a headline
card.fires_on: The space or line break right after a dated header such as a weekday and full date, just before a new article title or post begins. Also seen after short section labels or volume lines.

modes.label: After weekday date
modes.description: The break following a line like 'Sunday, May 19, 2013' just before the headline.
modes.example: Monday, February 2, 2009<< >>Flu season is making a slow start

modes.label: After a label or volume line
modes.description: The break after a short heading or journal issue line, before the title text.
modes.example: Volume 12, Number 10—October 2006<< >>Antimicrobial Drugs in the Home,

card.writes: It slightly favors bracket and heading-style openers such as ' [' and ' Signs', so it nudges the next text toward a title or list start.
card.plain: It marks the point right after a posted date where a new article title is about to start.
